command.name: security key-manager key key-table create
command.description: This command creates an entry in the key manager key table. It does not create a new key.

parameter.name: key-id
parameter.description: This parameter specifies the key ID of the new entry in the table.

parameter.name: key-type
parameter.description: This parameter specifies the key type of the new entry. The following key types are supported: NSE-AK, AEK, VEK, NEK and SVM-KEK.

parameter.name: encryption-algorithm
parameter.description: This parameter specifies the encryption algorithm associated with the key.

parameter.name: creation-time
parameter.description: This parameter specifies the date and time that the key was created. The date and time format is "MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS".

example.p: The following example creates an entry in the table:
example.screen:
cluster-1::> security key-manager key key-table create -key-id 00000000000000000200000000000500e9ccf3f08e7533d9cd0298e1ebe6c1000000000000000000 -key-type SVM-KEK -encryption-algorithm AES-256 -creation-time 01/01/2022 01:01:59
cluster-1::> security key-manager key key-table show
Key ID Key Type Encryption Creation Time --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------- ------------ -------------------- 00000000000000000200000000000500e9ccf3f08e7533d9cd0298e1ebe6c1000000000000000000 SVM-KEK AES-256 1/1/2022 01:01:59 1 entry was displayed.
